steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each role is placed by its allocation against 100 percent and whether demand exists behind it.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Skill needed with no one holding it
findings.fix: Hire or train for the skill

findings.title: Demand with no project behind it
findings.fix: Name the project or remove the demand

outcome.notChecked: Individual performance and availability beyond the sheet.

[medium] role-design:19  Skill needed with no one holding it.
       Fix: Hire or train for the skill.
[low] role-ops:26  Demand with no project behind it.

pros: Checks a role over-allocated above 100 percent, a demand with no project behind it, and a skill needed with no one holding it.
cons: Not checked: Individual performance and availability beyond the sheet.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-resource-plan skill on the records for this review.
